name: Golden Hour
description: A refreshing dry cider with a luminous straw-gold hue. Its aroma evokes fresh apple skins, subtly intertwined with notes of cinnamon and vanilla, though no spices were added during its creation. Clean bright taste with refreshing tartness perfectly balanced by a touch of sweetness. Perfect for any occasion.

name: Reverie Hazy Pale Ale
description: With bright tropical fruit on the palate and a fluffy, pillowy body, Reverie is sure to keep your head in the clouds dreaming of summer.

name: Baja Blast - Tropical Lime Sour
description: A tropical smoothie style sour inspired by a certain fast food taco spot’s exclusive soft drink flavour. Baja Blast. Brewed with additions of lime, coconut, pineapple, lemona, and our secret ingredient Blue Spuralina.

name: Salted Lime Lager
description: A light, latin american cerveza type beer with a modern twist. This is a crisp, clean lager made with Mexican limes and world-renowned salt sourced from El Valle Salado.

name: Merri Berri
description: A refreshing blend of local apples fermented slowly, then blended with BC black currant, cherry and raspberry juices. Sweet, but balanced with acidity and mild tannins from the black currant and raspberry. Great as a summertime favourite on the patio, at music festivals, or even on colder days when you need a little taste of summer.

name: Agave Maria - Tequila Shandy Sour
description: Crafted with real tequila, zesty lime, and a touch of sea salt, our Tequila Shandy Sour Ale offers a unique experience. The fragrant tequila aroma and refreshing lime zest blend seamlessly with a moderate, balanced sourness and a subtle salinity, creating the perfect summery, cocktail-inspired sour ale.

name: Ancient Grains West African Coast Session Ale
description: Brewed in collaboration with Country Malt Group to celebrate the World Cup, this hoppy session ale features the unique addition of fonio, an ancient African grain that lends distinctive tropical fruit notes. Idaho 7, Mosaic and Sabro hops contribute refined aromas of white wine, lychee, gooseberry and cataloupe, balanced by a subtle creamy character. It offers a soft, pillowy mouthfeel and a clean, refreshing bitterness- a versatile and sessionable brew.

name: Bierfest German Pilsner
description: Refreshingly floral, citrusy, and minty hop aroma and flavour from German Hallertau Mittelfrueh, and Saphir hops. Rich et light, crisp grainy, malt character from German and Canadian Pilsner malt. Thirst quenching,

name: Bierfest Hefeweizen
description: Unfiltered hazy German wheat ale. Light banana ester and clove phenol from a German wheat ale yeast. Bready, doughy wheat malt flavour with chewy, creamy mouthfeel.

name: Bierfest Schwarzbier
description: A dry dark German lager with restraint roastiness. Moderate date chocolate notes on the crisp bready malt backbone. Light floral hop notes. Medium-high bitterness. Dry, very clean finsih. Surprisingly easy drinking for it's dark appearance.

name: Cloud Breaker - Pineapple Coconut Sour
description: This refreshing sour ale was brewed with real pineapple and coconut to capture the essence of a classic piña colada. The beer opens with a vibrant, tropical aroma that leads into a light, clean sourness, making it incredibly quaffable. Perfectly balanced and dangerously easy drinking, this brew is the ultimate companion for sun-drenched afternoons and warm-weather gatherings.

name: Craft IPA
description: An easy-drinking West Coast IPA. Aroma and flavour of passionfruit, blueberry, gooseberry, and grapefruit. Firm pleasant bitterness. Grainy malt with a slight hint of toffee and sweetness. Light body and clean dry finish.

name: Craft Lager
description: A light, clean lager with a hint of malt and subtle hop flavour. An iconic East Van beer. Clean, crisp and refreshing. A pale lager brewed with all malted barley and local Sterling hops grown at Sartori Cedar Ranch in Chilliwack, BC. Fermented cool using a traditional German lager yeast.

name: Craft Lager Light
description: A “light” version of P49’s Craft Lager…Clean, light-bodied, very refreshing and thirst-quenching pale lager. Low on both malt and hop flavour but not as flavourless as the "light" beers from macro breweries

name: Craft Pilsner
description: Inspired by the traditional Czech Pilsner style,this beer is crisp and refreshing with a rich and complex bready maltiness complimented by the slightly spicy and floral hop character.

name: Crimson Crush Watermelon Raspberry Sour
description: This easy-drinking and refreshing Raspberry Watermelon Sour Wheat Ale offers a fragrant, upfront raspberry aroma leading into a refreshing and soothing watermelon aftertaste. The sourness is light, making it exceptionally approachable, and it pours a beautiful pale crimson colour with a light haze.

name: Disco Freezer Cold Pale Ale
description: A cold pale and hoppy ale brewed with lager yeast to achieve the clean, crisp, refreshing character of a lager combined with the substantial flavor of a pale ale. It is brewed with Red Shed Malt’s Penhold Pilsner malt and a blend of Krush, Mosaic, and Nelson Sauvin hops, which deliver notes of passionfruit, white grape, grapefruit, and a hint of berries. This brew features a light, grainy malt profile, a medium-high bitterness, and a crisp, dry finish.

name: Filthy Dirty West Coast IPA
description:
A west coast IPA with a ton of hop flavour and aroma.
 Subtle sweet malt flavour backs up the huge amount of orange,
 grapefruit, pine and floral aromas this beer expels.

name: Ginja Turtles
description: This easy-drinking sour ale features a refreshing blend of earthy ginger and zesty lime. It offers a clean, moderate sourness reminiscent of ginger limeade, complemented by an inviting citrus aroma and a subtle ginger-induced tingling on the palate.

name: Jerkface 9000 Northwest Wheat Ale
description: An easy drinking American wheat ale dry hopped with Mosaic Hops. Juicy citrus, tropical, and floral hop notes sit atop a light grainy malt base giving the beer and very flavourful hop punch with a light refreshing body.

name: Kiwi Cooler - New Zealand Wheat IPA
description: This wheat IPA was brewed in collaboration with Country Malt Group to celebrate the World Cup featuring New Zealand hops, Nelson Sauvin and Motueka. It boasts a huge fruit notes of kiwi, lychee, white grape, and guava, balanced by a soft, velvety, and chewy mouthfeel derived from a large portion of wheat. A firm bitterness ensures for a crisp finish.

name: Lime Lager
description: A crisp, and refreshing Mexican-style lager.

name: Limitless GF Lager
description: A gluten-free lager brewed without using gluten-containing ingredients. Delicate herbal and spicy German Perle hop character.

name: Lost Souls Chocolate Pumpkin Porter
description: All treat, no trick: this rich, robust Chocolate Pumpkin Porter is so good, even the living dead will indulge.

name: Micro-Dose
description: An ultimate sessionable blond ale, meticulously crafted to offer refreshing flavor without the full commitment

name: N2 Craft Stout
description: A dry Caribbean style stout with rich coffee and chocolate notes. Beautiful cascade and smooth velvety mouthfeel from the nitro.

name: Old Boy Classic Ale
description: Rich malt flavours of caramel, toffee and light chocolate. This ale is an ode to the pub beers of England. Well balanced flavours of malts and hops make this beer a classic.

name: Penny Farthing - English Mild
description: This English dark mild ale was brewed in collaboration with Country Malt Group to celebrate the World Cup. It features notes of hazelnuts and dark toast with a hint of brown sugar and raisin. Light and dry with a moderate bitterness, it is a highly crushable yet malty and flavorful ale long celebrated in British pub culture.

name: Pink Power Sour
description: Vibrant and empowering Tropical Hibiscus POG(passionfruit, orange, guava).

name: Rad-Berry Turbo Raspberry Lemonade Radler
description: Rad-Berry Turbo is a high-octane take on the classic summer refresher, clocking in at a 7.0% ABV. This extra-strong raspberry lemon radler opens with an aromatic burst of sun-ripened berries and sharp, zesty citrus. Built on a crisp, clean high-gravity lager base, it delivers an immediate wave of juicy raspberry sweetness that is expertly balanced by the refreshing, tart tang of lemonade.

name: Red Sled Citra Amber Lager
description: This clean, easy-drinking amber lager has a light yet rich grainy malt with a hint of biscuit and nuttiness. A moderately low bitterness provides balance, with a delicate citrus and herbal aroma from the restrained use of Citra hop. Its inviting light amber color makes it an ideal companion for the colder season.

name: Space Kitty
description: Hoppy, sessionable juicy IPA. Hop aroma of pineappple, mango, peach, pear, and lime from Mosaic, Amarillo and Citra Cryo dryhop. Light crisp grainy malt flavour. Light ceamy mouthfeel from oats and wheat. Quite hazy but not too thick. Great combination of juicy, hoppy, and sessionable.

name: Trash Panda Northeast Hazy IPA
description: Trash Panda uses huge amounts of dry hopping, giving this beer complex notes of melon, tropical fruit and pear. Its hop and malt varieties leave a visible haziness and smooth, juicy mouth feel.

name: Tricycle Grapefruit Radler
description: A classic German summer thirst-quenching mix of Bavarian lager and fresh grapefruit juice.

name: Ultraviolet Underground - Blueberry Lavender Sour
description: A unique Sour Ale brewed with real culinary lavender flowers and blueberries, this beer presents a fragrant and perfectly balanced fresh lavender aroma. The palate reveals a light blueberry flavor, finishing with a subtle hint of blueberry skin polyphenol, all contained within a striking deep purple colour.

name: What's in Shed? - Tool Shed collab
description: This unique Session IPA, brewed in collaboration with Tool Shed Brewing in Calgary, is a testament to fresh flavor, featuring the innovative Cryo Fresh Krush hops from Yakima Chief Hops. By using this concentrated, unkilned pellet hops made from harvest-fresh whole-cone hops, we've captured an incredibly vivid and intense aroma, bursting with notes of freshly-squeezed red grapefruit, exotic yuzu, guava, passionfruit, and a hint of gooseberry. Delivering assertive bitterness that quickly yields to a refreshingly dry finish, leaving behind a delightful and long-lasting tropical fruit aftertaste.

name: The Hoff Hefeweizen
description: Cloudy. Golden. Unreasonably good-looking. Loaded with banana and clove notes, topped with a fluffy head, and ready for it's slow-motion beach run into your weekend.

name: House Hazy IPA
description: St Augustines Hazy IPA

description: Bavarian-style craft lager by Parallel 49.

name: Pumpkin Ale

Failry dry finish with gentle tannin and salinity in the aftertaste.

name: Red Sled Citra Amber Lager
description: This clean, easy-drinking amber lager has a light yet rich grainy malt with a hint of biscuit and nuttiness. A moderately low bitterness provides balance, with a citrus and herbal aroma from the restrained use of Citra hop. Its light amber color makes it an ideal companion for the colder season.

name: Schadenfreude Pumpkin Oktoberfest
description: This hearty, malty lager is warmed by the mighty pumpkin and lifted with notes of cinnamon, nutmeg, all-spice and ginger

name: Space Kitty
description: Hoppy, sessionable juicy IPA. Hop aroma of pineappple, mango, peach, pear, and lime from Mosaic, Amarillo and Citra Cryo dryhop. Light crisp grainy malt flavour. Light ceamy mouthfeel from oats and wheat. Great combination of juicy, hoppy, and sessionable.

name: Trash Panda Northeast Hazy IPA
description: Trash Panda uses huge amounts of dry hopping, giving this beer complex notes of melon, tropical fruit and pear. Its hop and malt varieties leave a visible haziness and smooth, juicy mouth feel.

name: Tricycle Grapefruit Radler
description: A classic German summer thirst-quenching mix of Bavarian lager and fresh grapefruit juice.

name: Ultraviolet Underground - Blueberry Lavender Sour
description: A unique sour brewed with lavender flowers and blueberries, this beer presents a fragrant and perfectly balanced fresh lavender aroma. The palate reveals a light blueberry flavor, finishing with a hint of blueberry skin polyphenol, all within a striking deep purple colour.

name: What's in Shed? - Tool Shed collab
description: This unique Session IPA, brewed in collaboration with Tool Shed Brewing in Calgary features the innovative Cryo Fresh Krush hops from Yakima Chief Hops. By using this concentrated, unkilned pellet hops made from harvest-fresh whole-cone hops, we've captured an incredibly vivid and intense aroma, bursting with notes ofred grapefruit, yuzu, guava, passionfruit, and a hint of gooseberry. Delivering assertive bitterness that yields to a refreshingly dry finish.

name: The Hoff Hefeweizen
description: Cloudy. Golden. Unreasonably good-looking. Loaded with banana and clove notes, topped with a fluffy head, and ready for it's slow-motion beach run into your weekend.

name: Idleback Amber Ale
description: This amber ale combines the best ingredients that Europe and North America have to offer. Belgian crystal malts provide notes of dark fruit and raisins and Cascade hops provide a slight bitterness and a hint of fresh pine.

name: House Hazy IPA
description: St Augustines Hazy IPA

name: House Lager
description: Bavarian-style craft lager by Parallel 49.

name: House Pale Ale
description: A true balance of malt and hops that showcase the bready,caramel flavours of malted barley and the citrus, stone-fruit aromas of hops grown in the Pacific Northwest. Refreshingly drinkable and full of flavour.

name: Pumpkin Ale
description: This malt forward ale is brewed with hundreds of pounds of pumpkin and punched up with a proprietary blend of seasonal baking spices. It has a pie crust like backbone but doesn't finish overly sweet.

name: Colour & Shape
description: This is the kind of IPA we dream about. Unfiltered so nothing of the greatness gets lost. It is soft, with lots of tropical fruit notes and a touch of herbal quality. Incredibly drinkable and super delicious.

name: Easy Tiger
description: A wheat-based pale ale, our little hoppy beer is moderately dry-hopped with a blend of American and Australian hops. Pours a hazy, pale orange colour with bright carbonation. Delicate on the palate, we get citrus/orange zest, guava, fresh cut grass and a dry, yet soft finish.

name: Premium Rice Lager
description: Extra light, dry, and refreshing, this lager has little floral and lemon notes from the hops combined with smoothness from the rice.

name: Dreamboat Hazy IPA
description: This limited release unfiltered IPA has waves of fresh melon and hand squeezed citrus notes from a happy blend of Cashmere, Lemondrop, Citra, and Azacca hops. A juicy treat that lingers like a hazy dream.

name: Tilt-A-Whirl
description: Tilt-A-Whirl begins with pineapple on the palate, it's creamy soft-serve body and eventually slows to reveal a lightly-sweet vanilla finish.

name: Golden Hour
description: A refreshing dry cider with a luminous straw-gold hue. Its aroma evokes fresh apple skins, with notes of cinnamon and vanilla, though no spices were added during its creation. Clean bright taste with refreshing tartness perfectly balanced by a touch of sweetness. Perfect for any occasion.

name: Reverie Hazy Pale Ale
description: With bright tropical fruit on the palate and a fluffy, pillowy body, Reverie is sure to keep your head in the clouds dreaming of summer.

name: Mango Kolsch
description: Light, crisp and easy drinking, featuring subtle sweetness from Mexican Ataulfo mangoes.

name: Salted Lime Lager
description: A light, latin american cerveza type beer with a modern twist. This is a crisp, clean lager made with Mexican limes and world-renowned salt sourced from El Valle Salado.

name: Merri Berri
description: A refreshing blend of local apples fermented slowly, then blended with black currant, cherry and raspberry juices. Sweet, but balanced with acidity and mild tannins from the berries.

name: Agave Maria - Tequila Shandy Sour
description: Crafted with real tequila, zesty lime, and a touch of sea salt, our Tequila Shandy Sour Ale offers a unique experience. The fragrant tequila aroma and refreshing lime zest blend seamlessly with a moderate, balanced sourness and a subtle salinity, creating the perfect summery, cocktail-inspired sour ale.

name: Ancient Grains West African Coast Session Ale
description: Brewed in collaboration with Country Malt Group to celebrate the World Cup, this hoppy session ale features the unique addition of fonio, an ancient African grain that lends tropical fruit notes. Idaho 7, Mosaic and Sabro hops contribute aromas of white wine, lychee, gooseberry and cataloupe, balanced by a subtle creamy character. It offers a soft, pillowy mouthfeel and a clean, refreshing bitterness.

name: Bierfest German Pilsner
description: Refreshingly floral, citrusy, and minty hop aroma and flavour from German Hallertau Mittelfrueh, and Saphir hops. Crisp, grainy, malt character from German and Canadian Pilsner malt.

name: Bierfest Hefeweizen
description: Unfiltered hazy German wheat ale. Light banana ester and clove phenol from a German wheat ale yeast. Bready, doughy wheat malt flavour with chewy, creamy mouthfeel.

name: Bierfest Schwarzbier
description: A dry, dark German lager with restraint roastiness. Moderate date chocolate notes on the crisp bready malt backbone. Light floral hop notes. Medium-high bitterness. Dry, very clean finish.

name: Cloud Breaker
description: This refreshing sour ale was brewed with real pineapple and coconut to capture the essence of a classic piña colada. The beer opens with a tropical aroma that leads into a light, clean sourness, making it incredibly quaffable. Perfectly balanced and very easy drinking.

name: Craft IPA
description: An easy-drinking West Coast IPA. Aroma and flavour of passionfruit, blueberry, gooseberry, and grapefruit. Firm pleasant bitterness. Grainy malt with a slight hint of toffee and sweetness. Light body and clean dry finish.

name: Craft Lager
description: A light, clean lager with a hint of malt and subtle hop flavour. An iconic East Van beer. Clean, crisp and refreshing. A pale lager brewed with all malted barley and local Sterling hops grown at Sartori Cedar Ranch in Chilliwack, BC. Fermented cool using a traditional German lager yeast.

name: Craft Lager Light
description: A “light” version of P49’s Craft Lager…Clean, light-bodied, very refreshing and thirst-quenching pale lager. Low on both malt and hop flavour but not flavourless.

name: Craft Pilsner
description: Inspired by the traditional Czech Pilsner style,this beer is crisp and refreshing with a rich and complex bready maltiness complimented by the slightly spicy and floral hop character.

name: Crimson Crush Watermelon Raspberry Sour
description: This easy-drinking and refreshings sour wheat ale offers a fragrant raspberry aroma leading into a refreshing watermelon aftertaste. The sourness is light, making it veyr approachable, and it pours a beautiful pale crimson colour.

name: Disco Freezer Cold Pale Ale
description: A pale and hoppy ale brewed with lager yeast to achieve the clean, crisp, refreshing character of a lager combined with the flavor of a pale ale. It is brewed with Red Shed Malt’s Penhold Pilsner malt and a blend of Krush, Mosaic, and Nelson Sauvin hops, which deliver notes of passionfruit, white grape, grapefruit, and a hint of berries. This brew features a light, grainy malt profile, a medium-high bitterness, and a crisp, dry finish.

name: Filthy Dirty West Coast IPA
description:
A west coast IPA with a ton of hop flavour and aroma.
 Subtle sweet malt flavour backs up the huge amount of orange,
 grapefruit, pine and floral aromas this beer expels.

name: Ginja Turtles
description: This easy-drinking sour ale features a refreshing blend of earthy ginger and zesty lime. It offers a clean, moderate sourness complemented by an inviting citrus aroma and a subtle ginger-induced tingling on the palate.

name: Jerkface 9000 Northwest Wheat Ale
description: An easy drinking American wheat ale dry hopped with Mosaic Hops. Juicy citrus, tropical, and floral hop notes sit atop a light grainy malt base giving the beer and very flavourful hop punch with a light refreshing body.

name: Kiwi Cooler - New Zealand Wheat IPA
description: This wheat IPA was brewed in collaboration with Country Malt Group to celebrate the World Cup featuring New Zealand hops, Nelson Sauvin and Motueka. It boasts a huge fruit notes of kiwi, lychee, white grape, and guava, balanced by a soft, velvety, and chewy mouthfeel derived from a large portion of wheat. A firm bitterness ensures for a crisp finish.

name: Lime Lager
description: A crisp, and refreshing Mexican-style lager.

name: Limitless GF Lager
description: A gluten-free lager brewed without using gluten-containing ingredients. Delicate herbal and spicy German Perle hop character.

name: Lost Souls Chocolate Pumpkin Porter
description: All treat, no trick: this rich, robust Chocolate Pumpkin Porter is so good, even the living dead will indulge.

name: N2 Craft Stout
description: A dry Caribbean style stout with rich coffee and chocolate notes. Beautiful cascade and smooth velvety mouthfeel from the nitro.

name: Old Boy Classic Ale
description: Rich malt flavours of caramel, toffee and light chocolate. This ale is an ode to the pub beers of England. Well balanced flavours of malts and hops make this beer a classic.

name: Penny Farthing - English Mild
description: This English dark mild ale was brewed in collaboration with Country Malt Group to celebrate the World Cup. It features notes of hazelnuts and dark toast with a hint of brown sugar and raisin. Light and dry with a moderate bitterness, it is a highly crushable yet malty and flavorful ale long celebrated in British pub culture.

name: Pink Power Sour
description: Vibrant and empowering Tropical Hibiscus POG(passionfruit, orange, guava).

name: Rad-Berry Turbo Raspberry Lemonade Radler
description: This extra-strong raspberry lemon radler opens with an aromatic burst of sun-ripened berries and sharp, zesty citrus. Built on a crisp, clean lager base, it delivers a wave of juicy raspberry sweetness that is balanced by the refreshing, tart tang of lemonade.

name: Crimson Crush Watermelon Raspberry Sour
description: This easy-drinking and refreshings sour wheat ale offers a fragrant raspberry aroma leading into a refreshing watermelon aftertaste. The sourness is light, making it veyr approachable, and it pours a beautiful pale crimson colour.

name: Disco Freezer Cold Pale Ale
description: A pale and hoppy ale brewed with lager yeast to achieve the clean, crisp, refreshing character of a lager combined with the flavor of a pale ale. It is brewed with Red Shed Malt’s Penhold Pilsner malt and a blend of Krush, Mosaic, and Nelson Sauvin hops, which deliver notes of passionfruit, white grape, grapefruit, and a hint of berries. This brew features a light, grainy malt profile, a medium-high bitterness, and a crisp, dry finish.

name: Filthy Dirty West Coast IPA
description:
A west coast IPA with a ton of hop flavour and aroma.
 Subtle sweet malt flavour backs up the huge amount of orange,
 grapefruit, pine and floral aromas this beer expels.

name: Ginja Turtles
description: This easy-drinking sour ale features a refreshing blend of earthy ginger and zesty lime. It offers a clean, moderate sourness complemented by an inviting citrus aroma and a subtle ginger-induced tingling on the palate.

name: Jerkface 9000 Northwest Wheat Ale
description: An easy drinking American wheat ale dry hopped with Mosaic Hops. Juicy citrus, tropical, and floral hop notes sit atop a light grainy malt base giving the beer and very flavourful hop punch with a light refreshing body.

name: Kiwi Cooler - New Zealand Wheat IPA
description: This wheat IPA was brewed in collaboration with Country Malt Group to celebrate the World Cup featuring New Zealand hops, Nelson Sauvin and Motueka. It boasts a huge fruit notes of kiwi, lychee, white grape, and guava, balanced by a soft, velvety, and chewy mouthfeel derived from a large portion of wheat. A firm bitterness ensures for a crisp finish.

name: Lime Lager
description: A crisp, and refreshing Mexican-style lager.

name: Limitless GF Lager
description: A gluten-free lager brewed without using gluten-containing ingredients. Delicate herbal and spicy German Perle hop character.

name: Lost Souls Chocolate Pumpkin Porter
description: All treat, no trick: this rich, robust Chocolate Pumpkin Porter is so good, even the living dead will indulge.

name: N2 Craft Stout
description: A dry Caribbean style stout with rich coffee and chocolate notes. Beautiful cascade and smooth velvety mouthfeel from the nitro.

name: Old Boy Classic Ale
description: Rich malt flavours of caramel, toffee and light chocolate. This ale is an ode to the pub beers of England. Well balanced flavours of malts and hops make this beer a classic.

name: Penny Farthing - English Mild
description: This English dark mild ale was brewed in collaboration with Country Malt Group to celebrate the World Cup. It features notes of hazelnuts and dark toast with a hint of brown sugar and raisin. Light and dry with a moderate bitterness, it is a highly crushable yet malty and flavorful ale long celebrated in British pub culture.

name: Pink Power Sour
description: Vibrant and empowering Tropical Hibiscus POG(passionfruit, orange, guava).

name: Rad-Berry Turbo Raspberry Lemonade Radler
description: This extra-strong raspberry lemon radler opens with an aromatic burst of sun-ripened berries and sharp, zesty citrus. Built on a crisp, clean lager base, it delivers a wave of juicy raspberry sweetness that is balanced by the refreshing, tart tang of lemonade.

name: Reckless Enthusiasm
description: We collaborated with Blind Enthusiasm Brewery in Edmonton to merge our award winning Brett Saison recipe and Blind Enthusiasm's house microbe culture sourced directly from their barrels. Dryhopped with Amarillo and Saphir after 4 months of fermentaion, then keg conditioned for natural carbonation. Passionfruit, lime, pineapple and apricot flavor with a hint of funk. Failry dry finish with gentle tannin and salinity in the aftertaste.

name: Red Sled Citra Amber Lager
description: This clean, easy-drinking amber lager has a light yet rich grainy malt with a hint of biscuit and nuttiness. A moderately low bitterness provides balance, with a citrus and herbal aroma from the restrained use of Citra hop. Its light amber color makes it an ideal companion for the colder season.

name: Schadenfreude Pumpkin Oktoberfest
description: This hearty, malty lager is warmed by the mighty pumpkin and lifted with notes of cinnamon, nutmeg, all-spice and ginger

name: Space Kitty
description: Hoppy, sessionable juicy IPA. Hop aroma of pineappple, mango, peach, pear, and lime from Mosaic, Amarillo and Citra Cryo dryhop. Light crisp grainy malt flavour. Light ceamy mouthfeel from oats and wheat. Great combination of juicy, hoppy, and sessionable.

name: Trash Panda Northeast Hazy IPA
description: Trash Panda uses huge amounts of dry hopping, giving this beer complex notes of melon, tropical fruit and pear. Its hop and malt varieties leave a visible haziness and smooth, juicy mouth feel.

name: Tricycle Grapefruit Radler
description: A classic German summer thirst-quenching mix of Bavarian lager and fresh grapefruit juice.

name: Ultraviolet Underground - Blueberry Lavender Sour
description: A unique sour brewed with lavender flowers and blueberries, this beer presents a fragrant and perfectly balanced fresh lavender aroma. The palate reveals a light blueberry flavor, finishing with a hint of blueberry skin polyphenol, all within a striking deep purple colour.

name: What's in Shed? - Tool Shed collab
description: This unique Session IPA, brewed in collaboration with Tool Shed Brewing in Calgary features the innovative Cryo Fresh Krush hops from Yakima Chief Hops. By using this concentrated, unkilned pellet hops made from harvest-fresh whole-cone hops, we've captured an incredibly vivid and intense aroma, bursting with notes ofred grapefruit, yuzu, guava, passionfruit, and a hint of gooseberry. Delivering assertive bitterness that yields to a refreshingly dry finish.

name: The Hoff Hefeweizen
description: Cloudy. Golden. Unreasonably good-looking. Loaded with banana and clove notes, topped with a fluffy head, and ready for it's slow-motion beach run into your weekend.

name: Idleback Amber Ale
description: This amber ale combines the best ingredients that Europe and North America have to offer. Belgian crystal malts provide notes of dark fruit and raisins and Cascade hops provide a slight bitterness and a hint of fresh pine.

name: House Hazy IPA
description: St Augustines Hazy IPA

name: House Lager
description: Bavarian-style craft lager by Parallel 49.

name: House Pale Ale
description: A true balance of malt and hops that showcase the bready,caramel flavours of malted barley and the citrus, stone-fruit aromas of hops grown in the Pacific Northwest. Refreshingly drinkable and full of flavour.

name: Pumpkin Ale
description: This malt forward ale is brewed with hundreds of pounds of pumpkin and punched up with a proprietary blend of seasonal baking spices. It has a pie crust like backbone but doesn't finish overly sweet.

name: Colour & Shape
description: This is the kind of IPA we dream about. Unfiltered so nothing of the greatness gets lost. It is soft, with lots of tropical fruit notes and a touch of herbal quality. Incredibly drinkable and super delicious.

name: Easy Tiger
description: A wheat-based pale ale, our little hoppy beer is moderately dry-hopped with a blend of American and Australian hops. Pours a hazy, pale orange colour with bright carbonation. Delicate on the palate, we get citrus/orange zest, guava, fresh cut grass and a dry, yet soft finish.

name: Premium Rice Lager
description: Extra light, dry, and refreshing, this lager has little floral and lemon notes from the hops combined with smoothness from the rice.

name: Dreamboat Hazy IPA
description: This limited release unfiltered IPA has waves of fresh melon and hand squeezed citrus notes from a happy blend of Cashmere, Lemondrop, Citra, and Azacca hops. A juicy treat that lingers like a hazy dream.

name: Tilt-A-Whirl
description: Tilt-A-Whirl begins with pineapple on the palate, it's creamy soft-serve body and eventually slows to reveal a lightly-sweet vanilla finish.

name: Golden Hour
description: A refreshing dry cider with a luminous straw-gold hue. Its aroma evokes fresh apple skins, with notes of cinnamon and vanilla, though no spices were added during its creation. Clean bright taste with refreshing tartness perfectly balanced by a touch of sweetness. Perfect for any occasion.

name: Reverie Hazy Pale Ale
description: With bright tropical fruit on the palate and a fluffy, pillowy body, Reverie is sure to keep your head in the clouds dreaming of summer.

name: Mango Kolsch
description: Light, crisp and easy drinking, featuring subtle sweetness from Mexican Ataulfo mangoes.

name: Salted Lime Lager
description: A light, latin american cerveza type beer with a modern twist. This is a crisp, clean lager made with Mexican limes and world-renowned salt sourced from El Valle Salado.

name: Merri Berri
description: A refreshing blend of local apples fermented slowly, then blended with black currant, cherry and raspberry juices. Sweet, but balanced with acidity and mild tannins from the berries.

name: Agave Maria - Tequila Shandy Sour
description: Crafted with real tequila, zesty lime, and a touch of sea salt, our Tequila Shandy Sour Ale offers a unique experience. The fragrant tequila aroma and refreshing lime zest blend seamlessly with a moderate, balanced sourness and a subtle salinity, creating the perfect summery, cocktail-inspired sour ale.

name: House Hazy IPA
description: St Augustines Hazy IPA

name: House Lager

name: House Pale Ale

name: Colour & Shape
description: This is the kind of IPA we dream about. Unfiltered so nothing of the greatness gets lost. It is soft, with lots of tropical fruit notes and a touch of herbal quality. Incredibly drinkable and super delicious.

name: Happyness IPA
description: A crisp malt body, green tropical fruit, lime, guava pepper notes and a soft bitterness. Hopped with Mosaic and Citra.

name: Premium Rice Lager
description: Extra light, dry, and refreshing, this lager has little floral and lemon notes from the hops combined with smoothness from the rice.

name: Dreamboat Hazy IPA
description: This limited release unfiltered IPA has waves of fresh melon and hand squeezed citrus notes from a happy blend of Cashmere, Lemondrop, Citra, and Azacca hops. A juicy treat that lingers like a hazy dream.

name: Tilt-A-Whirl
description: Tilt-A-Whirl begins with pineapple on the palate, it's creamy soft-serve body and eventually slows to reveal a lightly-sweet vanilla finish.

name: Golden Hour
description: A refreshing dry cider with a luminous straw-gold hue. Its aroma evokes fresh apple skins, with notes of cinnamon and vanilla, though no spices were added during its creation. Clean bright taste with refreshing tartness perfectly balanced by a touch of sweetness. Perfect for any occasion.

name: Lionheart London Porter
description: This London Porter is brewed with roasty, rich and velvety malts that honour the 18th-century British classic.

name: Mango Kolsch
description: Light, crisp and easy drinking, featuring subtle sweetness from Mexican Ataulfo mangoes.

name: Salted Lime Lager
description: A light, latin american cerveza type beer with a modern twist. This is a crisp, clean lager made with Mexican limes and world-renowned salt sourced from El Valle Salado.

name: Merri Berri
description: A refreshing blend of local apples fermented slowly, then blended with black currant, cherry and raspberry juices. Sweet, but balanced with acidity and mild tannins from the berries.

name: Agave Maria - Tequila Shandy Sour
description: Crafted with real tequila, zesty lime, and a touch of sea salt, our Tequila Shandy Sour Ale offers a unique experience. The fragrant tequila aroma and refreshing lime zest blend seamlessly with a moderate, balanced sourness and a subtle salinity, creating the perfect summery, cocktail-inspired sour ale.

name: Ancient Grains West African Coast Session Ale
description: Brewed in collaboration with Country Malt Group to celebrate the World Cup, this hoppy session ale features the unique addition of fonio, an ancient African grain that lends tropical fruit notes. Idaho 7, Mosaic and Sabro hops contribute aromas of white wine, lychee, gooseberry and cataloupe, balanced by a subtle creamy character. It offers a soft, pillowy mouthfeel and a clean, refreshing bitterness.

name: Bierfest German Pilsner
description: Refreshingly floral, citrusy, and minty hop aroma and flavour from German Hallertau Mittelfrueh, and Saphir hops. Crisp, grainy, malt character from German and Canadian Pilsner malt.

name: Bierfest Hefeweizen
description: Unfiltered hazy German wheat ale. Light banana ester and clove phenol from a German wheat ale yeast. Bready, doughy wheat malt flavour with chewy, creamy mouthfeel.

name: Bierfest Schwarzbier
description: A dry, dark German lager with restraint roastiness. Moderate date chocolate notes on the crisp bready malt backbone. Light floral hop notes. Medium-high bitterness. Dry, very clean finish.

name: Cloud Breaker
description: This refreshing sour ale was brewed with real pineapple and coconut to capture the essence of a classic piña colada. The beer opens with a tropical aroma that leads into a light, clean sourness, making it incredibly quaffable. Perfectly balanced and very easy drinking.

name: Craft IPA
description: An easy-drinking West Coast IPA. Aroma and flavour of passionfruit, blueberry, gooseberry, and grapefruit. Firm pleasant bitterness. Grainy malt with a slight hint of toffee and sweetness. Light body and clean dry finish.

name: Craft Lager
description: A light, clean lager with a hint of malt and subtle hop flavour. An iconic East Van beer. Clean, crisp and refreshing. A pale lager brewed with all malted barley and local Sterling hops grown at Sartori Cedar Ranch in Chilliwack, BC. Fermented cool using a traditional German lager yeast.

name: Craft Lager Light
description: A “light” version of P49’s Craft Lager…Clean, light-bodied, very refreshing and thirst-quenching pale lager. Low on both malt and hop flavour but not flavourless.

name: Craft Pilsner
description: Inspired by the traditional Czech Pilsner style,this beer is crisp and refreshing with a rich and complex bready maltiness complimented by the slightly spicy and floral hop character.

name: Crimson Crush Watermelon Raspberry Sour
description: This easy-drinking and refreshings sour wheat ale offers a fragrant raspberry aroma leading into a refreshing watermelon aftertaste. The sourness is light, making it veyr approachable, and it pours a beautiful pale crimson colour.

name: Disco Freezer Cold Pale Ale
description: A pale and hoppy ale brewed with lager yeast to achieve the clean, crisp, refreshing character of a lager combined with the flavor of a pale ale. It is brewed with Red Shed Malt’s Penhold Pilsner malt and a blend of Krush, Mosaic, and Nelson Sauvin hops, which deliver notes of passionfruit, white grape, grapefruit, and a hint of berries. This brew features a light, grainy malt profile, a medium-high bitterness, and a crisp, dry finish.

name: Filthy Dirty West Coast IPA
description:
A west coast IPA with a ton of hop flavour and aroma.
 Subtle sweet malt flavour backs up the huge amount of orange,
 grapefruit, pine and floral aromas this beer expels.

name: Ginja Turtles
description: This easy-drinking sour ale features a refreshing blend of earthy ginger and zesty lime. It offers a clean, moderate sourness complemented by an inviting citrus aroma and a subtle ginger-induced tingling on the palate.

name: Jerkface 9000 Northwest Wheat Ale
description: An easy drinking American wheat ale dry hopped with Mosaic Hops. Juicy citrus, tropical, and floral hop notes sit atop a light grainy malt base giving the beer and very flavourful hop punch with a light refreshing body.

name: Kiwi Cooler - New Zealand Wheat IPA
description: This wheat IPA was brewed in collaboration with Country Malt Group to celebrate the World Cup featuring New Zealand hops, Nelson Sauvin and Motueka. It boasts a huge fruit notes of kiwi, lychee, white grape, and guava, balanced by a soft, velvety, and chewy mouthfeel derived from a large portion of wheat. A firm bitterness ensures for a crisp finish.

name: Lime Lager
description: A crisp, and refreshing Mexican-style lager.

name: Limitless GF Lager
description: A gluten-free lager brewed without using gluten-containing ingredients. Delicate herbal and spicy German Perle hop character.

name: Lost Souls Chocolate Pumpkin Porter
description: All treat, no trick: this rich, robust Chocolate Pumpkin Porter is so good, even the living dead will indulge.

name: N2 Craft Stout
description: A dry Caribbean style stout with rich coffee and chocolate notes. Beautiful cascade and smooth velvety mouthfeel from the nitro.

name: Old Boy Classic Ale
description: Rich malt flavours of caramel, toffee and light chocolate. This ale is an ode to the pub beers of England. Well balanced flavours of malts and hops make this beer a classic.

name: Penny Farthing - English Mild
description: This English dark mild ale was brewed in collaboration with Country Malt Group to celebrate the World Cup. It features notes of hazelnuts and dark toast with a hint of brown sugar and raisin. Light and dry with a moderate bitterness, it is a highly crushable yet malty and flavorful ale long celebrated in British pub culture.

name: Pink Power Sour
description: Vibrant and empowering Tropical Hibiscus POG(passionfruit, orange, guava).

name: Rad-Berry Turbo Raspberry Lemonade Radler
description: This extra-strong raspberry lemon radler opens with an aromatic burst of sun-ripened berries and sharp, zesty citrus. Built on a crisp, clean lager base, it delivers a wave of juicy raspberry sweetness that is balanced by the refreshing, tart tang of lemonade.

name: Reckless Enthusiasm
description: We collaborated with Blind Enthusiasm Brewery in Edmonton to merge our award winning Brett Saison recipe and Blind Enthusiasm's house microbe culture sourced directly from their barrels. Dryhopped with Amarillo and Saphir after 4 months of fermentaion, then keg conditioned for natural carbonation. Passionfruit, lime, pineapple and apricot flavor with a hint of funk. Failry dry finish with gentle tannin and salinity in the aftertaste.

name: Red Sled Citra Amber Lager
description: This clean, easy-drinking amber lager has a light yet rich grainy malt with a hint of biscuit and nuttiness. A moderately low bitterness provides balance, with a citrus and herbal aroma from the restrained use of Citra hop. Its light amber color makes it an ideal companion for the colder season.

name: Schadenfreude Pumpkin Oktoberfest
description: This hearty, malty lager is warmed by the mighty pumpkin and lifted with notes of cinnamon, nutmeg, all-spice and ginger

name: Space Kitty
description: Hoppy, sessionable juicy IPA. Hop aroma of pineappple, mango, peach, pear, and lime from Mosaic, Amarillo and Citra Cryo dryhop. Light crisp grainy malt flavour. Light ceamy mouthfeel from oats and wheat. Great combination of juicy, hoppy, and sessionable.

name: Trash Panda Northeast Hazy IPA
description: Trash Panda uses huge amounts of dry hopping, giving this beer complex notes of melon, tropical fruit and pear. Its hop and malt varieties leave a visible haziness and smooth, juicy mouth feel.

name: Tricycle Grapefruit Radler
description: A classic German summer thirst-quenching mix of Bavarian lager and fresh grapefruit juice.

name: Ultraviolet Underground - Blueberry Lavender Sour
description: A unique sour brewed with lavender flowers and blueberries, this beer presents a fragrant and perfectly balanced fresh lavender aroma. The palate reveals a light blueberry flavor, finishing with a hint of blueberry skin polyphenol, all within a striking deep purple colour.

name: What's in Shed? - Tool Shed collab
description: This unique Session IPA, brewed in collaboration with Tool Shed Brewing in Calgary features the innovative Cryo Fresh Krush hops from Yakima Chief Hops. By using this concentrated, unkilned pellet hops made from harvest-fresh whole-cone hops, we've captured an incredibly vivid and intense aroma, bursting with notes ofred grapefruit, yuzu, guava, passionfruit, and a hint of gooseberry. Delivering assertive bitterness that yields to a refreshingly dry finish.

Failry dry finish with gentle tannin and salinity in the aftertaste.

name: Red Sled Citra Amber Lager
description: This clean, easy-drinking amber lager has a light yet rich grainy malt with a hint of biscuit and nuttiness. A moderately low bitterness provides balance, with a citrus and herbal aroma from the restrained use of Citra hop. Its light amber color makes it an ideal companion for the colder season.

name: Schadenfreude Pumpkin Oktoberfest
description: This hearty, malty lager is warmed by the mighty pumpkin and lifted with notes of cinnamon, nutmeg, all-spice and ginger

name: Space Kitty
description: Hoppy, sessionable juicy IPA. Hop aroma of pineappple, mango, peach, pear, and lime from Mosaic, Amarillo and Citra Cryo dryhop. Light crisp grainy malt flavour. Light ceamy mouthfeel from oats and wheat. Great combination of juicy, hoppy, and sessionable.

name: Trash Panda Northeast Hazy IPA
description: Trash Panda uses huge amounts of dry hopping, giving this beer complex notes of melon, tropical fruit and pear. Its hop and malt varieties leave a visible haziness and smooth, juicy mouth feel.

name: Tricycle Grapefruit Radler
description: A classic German summer thirst-quenching mix of Bavarian lager and fresh grapefruit juice.

name: Ultraviolet Underground - Blueberry Lavender Sour
description: A unique sour brewed with lavender flowers and blueberries, this beer presents a fragrant and perfectly balanced fresh lavender aroma. The palate reveals a light blueberry flavor, finishing with a hint of blueberry skin polyphenol, all within a striking deep purple colour.

name: What's in Shed? - Tool Shed collab
description: This unique Session IPA, brewed in collaboration with Tool Shed Brewing in Calgary features the innovative Cryo Fresh Krush hops from Yakima Chief Hops. By using this concentrated, unkilned pellet hops made from harvest-fresh whole-cone hops, we've captured an incredibly vivid and intense aroma, bursting with notes ofred grapefruit, yuzu, guava, passionfruit, and a hint of gooseberry. Delivering assertive bitterness that yields to a refreshingly dry finish.

name: Player 1
description: This New England style hazy IPA is defined by bright notes of citurs, peach and tangerine.

name: House Hazy IPA
description: St Augustines Hazy IPA

name: Colour & Shape
description: This is the kind of IPA we dream about. Unfiltered so nothing of the greatness gets lost. It is soft, with lots of tropical fruit notes and a touch of herbal quality. Incredibly drinkable and super delicious.

name: Happyness IPA
description: A crisp malt body, green tropical fruit, lime, guava pepper notes and a soft bitterness. Hopped with Mosaic and Citra.

name: Premium Rice Lager

name: Dreamboat Hazy IPA

name: Golden Hour
description: A refreshing dry cider with a luminous straw-gold hue. Its aroma evokes fresh apple skins, with notes of cinnamon and vanilla, though no spices were added during its creation. Clean bright taste with refreshing tartness perfectly balanced by a touch of sweetness. Perfect for any occasion.

name: Lionheart London Porter
description: This London Porter is brewed with roasty, rich and velvety malts that honour the 18th-century British classic.

name: Mango Kolsch
description: Light, crisp and easy drinking, featuring subtle sweetness from Mexican Ataulfo mangoes.

name: Salted Lime Lager
description: A light, latin american cerveza type beer with a modern twist. This is a crisp, clean lager made with Mexican limes and world-renowned salt sourced from El Valle Salado.

name: Merri Berri
description: A refreshing blend of local apples fermented slowly, then blended with black currant, cherry and raspberry juices. Sweet, but balanced with acidity and mild tannins from the berries.

name: Agave Maria - Tequila Shandy Sour
description: Crafted with real tequila, zesty lime, and a touch of sea salt, our Tequila Shandy Sour Ale offers a unique experience. The fragrant tequila aroma and refreshing lime zest blend seamlessly with a moderate, balanced sourness and a subtle salinity, creating the perfect summery, cocktail-inspired sour ale.

name: Ancient Grains West African Coast Session Ale
description: Brewed in collaboration with Country Malt Group to celebrate the World Cup, this hoppy session ale features the unique addition of fonio, an ancient African grain that lends tropical fruit notes. Idaho 7, Mosaic and Sabro hops contribute aromas of white wine, lychee, gooseberry and cataloupe, balanced by a subtle creamy character. It offers a soft, pillowy mouthfeel and a clean, refreshing bitterness.

name: Bierfest German Pilsner
description: Refreshingly floral, citrusy, and minty hop aroma and flavour from German Hallertau Mittelfrueh, and Saphir hops. Crisp, grainy, malt character from German and Canadian Pilsner malt.

name: Bierfest Hefeweizen
description: Unfiltered hazy German wheat ale. Light banana ester and clove phenol from a German wheat ale yeast. Bready, doughy wheat malt flavour with chewy, creamy mouthfeel.

name: Bierfest Schwarzbier
description: A dry, dark German lager with restraint roastiness. Moderate date chocolate notes on the crisp bready malt backbone. Light floral hop notes. Medium-high bitterness. Dry, very clean finish.

name: Cloud Breaker
description: This refreshing sour ale was brewed with real pineapple and coconut to capture the essence of a classic piña colada. The beer opens with a tropical aroma that leads into a light, clean sourness, making it incredibly quaffable. Perfectly balanced and very easy drinking.

name: Cobra Clutch DOUBLE IPA
description: Cobra Clutch is a hazy double IPA packed with vibrant flavors and aromas. Generously hopped with Ahtanum, Cascade, and Mosaic hops, it delivers juicy citrus, mango, and floral notes that perfectly complement its hazy and refreshing body. Despite its bold hop character and higher ABV, this DIPA remains smooth and easy-drinking, offering a fragrant and well-balanced experience. Ideal for hop enthusiasts, Cobra Clutch combines intensity with approachability in every sip.

name: Craft IPA
description: An easy-drinking West Coast IPA. Aroma and flavour of passionfruit, blueberry, gooseberry, and grapefruit. Firm pleasant bitterness. Grainy malt with a slight hint of toffee and sweetness. Light body and clean dry finish.

name: Craft Lager
description: A light, clean lager with a hint of malt and subtle hop flavour. An iconic East Van beer. Clean, crisp and refreshing. A pale lager brewed with all malted barley and local Sterling hops grown at Sartori Cedar Ranch in Chilliwack, BC. Fermented cool using a traditional German lager yeast.

name: Craft Lager Light
description: A “light” version of P49’s Craft Lager…Clean, light-bodied, very refreshing and thirst-quenching pale lager. Low on both malt and hop flavour but not flavourless.

name: Craft Pilsner
description: Inspired by the traditional Czech Pilsner style,this beer is crisp and refreshing with a rich and complex bready maltiness complimented by the slightly spicy and floral hop character.

name: Crimson Crush Watermelon Raspberry Sour
description: This easy-drinking and refreshings sour wheat ale offers a fragrant raspberry aroma leading into a refreshing watermelon aftertaste. The sourness is light, making it veyr approachable, and it pours a beautiful pale crimson colour.

name: Disco Freezer Cold Pale Ale
description: A pale and hoppy ale brewed with lager yeast to achieve the clean, crisp, refreshing character of a lager combined with the flavor of a pale ale. It is brewed with Red Shed Malt’s Penhold Pilsner malt and a blend of Krush, Mosaic, and Nelson Sauvin hops, which deliver notes of passionfruit, white grape, grapefruit, and a hint of berries. This brew features a light, grainy malt profile, a medium-high bitterness, and a crisp, dry finish.

name: Filthy Dirty West Coast IPA
description:
A west coast IPA with a ton of hop flavour and aroma.
 Subtle sweet malt flavour backs up the huge amount of orange,
 grapefruit, pine and floral aromas this beer expels.

name: Ginja Turtles
description: This easy-drinking sour ale features a refreshing blend of earthy ginger and zesty lime. It offers a clean, moderate sourness complemented by an inviting citrus aroma and a subtle ginger-induced tingling on the palate.

name: Jerkface 9000 Northwest Wheat Ale
description: An easy drinking American wheat ale dry hopped with Mosaic Hops. Juicy citrus, tropical, and floral hop notes sit atop a light grainy malt base giving the beer and very flavourful hop punch with a light refreshing body.

name: Kiwi Cooler - New Zealand Wheat IPA
description: This wheat IPA was brewed in collaboration with Country Malt Group to celebrate the World Cup featuring New Zealand hops, Nelson Sauvin and Motueka. It boasts a huge fruit notes of kiwi, lychee, white grape, and guava, balanced by a soft, velvety, and chewy mouthfeel derived from a large portion of wheat. A firm bitterness ensures for a crisp finish.

name: Lime Lager
description: A crisp, and refreshing Mexican-style lager.

name: Limitless GF Lager
description: A gluten-free lager brewed without using gluten-containing ingredients. Delicate herbal and spicy German Perle hop character.

name: Lost Souls Chocolate Pumpkin Porter
description: All treat, no trick: this rich, robust Chocolate Pumpkin Porter is so good, even the living dead will indulge.

name: N2 Craft Stout
description: A dry Caribbean style stout with rich coffee and chocolate notes. Beautiful cascade and smooth velvety mouthfeel from the nitro.

name: Old Boy Classic Ale
description: Rich malt flavours of caramel, toffee and light chocolate. This ale is an ode to the pub beers of England. Well balanced flavours of malts and hops make this beer a classic.

name: Penny Farthing - English Mild
description: This English dark mild ale was brewed in collaboration with Country Malt Group to celebrate the World Cup. It features notes of hazelnuts and dark toast with a hint of brown sugar and raisin. Light and dry with a moderate bitterness, it is a highly crushable yet malty and flavorful ale long celebrated in British pub culture.

name: Pink Power Sour
description: Vibrant and empowering Tropical Hibiscus POG(passionfruit, orange, guava).

description: Inspired by the traditional Czech Pilsner style,this beer is crisp and refreshing with a rich and complex bready maltiness complimented by the slightly spicy and floral hop character.

name: Crimson Crush Watermelon Raspberry Sour
description: This easy-drinking and refreshings sour wheat ale offers a fragrant raspberry aroma leading into a refreshing watermelon aftertaste. The sourness is light, making it veyr approachable, and it pours a beautiful pale crimson colour.

name: Disco Freezer Cold Pale Ale
description: A pale and hoppy ale brewed with lager yeast to achieve the clean, crisp, refreshing character of a lager combined with the flavor of a pale ale. It is brewed with Red Shed Malt’s Penhold Pilsner malt and a blend of Krush, Mosaic, and Nelson Sauvin hops, which deliver notes of passionfruit, white grape, grapefruit, and a hint of berries. This brew features a light, grainy malt profile, a medium-high bitterness, and a crisp, dry finish.

name: Filthy Dirty West Coast IPA
description:
A west coast IPA with a ton of hop flavour and aroma.
 Subtle sweet malt flavour backs up the huge amount of orange,
 grapefruit, pine and floral aromas this beer expels.

name: Ginja Turtles
description: This easy-drinking sour ale features a refreshing blend of earthy ginger and zesty lime. It offers a clean, moderate sourness complemented by an inviting citrus aroma and a subtle ginger-induced tingling on the palate.

name: Jerkface 9000 Northwest Wheat Ale
description: An easy drinking American wheat ale dry hopped with Mosaic Hops. Juicy citrus, tropical, and floral hop notes sit atop a light grainy malt base giving the beer and very flavourful hop punch with a light refreshing body.

name: Kiwi Cooler - New Zealand Wheat IPA
description: This wheat IPA was brewed in collaboration with Country Malt Group to celebrate the World Cup featuring New Zealand hops, Nelson Sauvin and Motueka. It boasts a huge fruit notes of kiwi, lychee, white grape, and guava, balanced by a soft, velvety, and chewy mouthfeel derived from a large portion of wheat. A firm bitterness ensures for a crisp finish.

name: Lime Lager
description: A crisp, and refreshing Mexican-style lager.

name: Limitless GF Lager
description: A gluten-free lager brewed without using gluten-containing ingredients. Delicate herbal and spicy German Perle hop character.

name: Lost Souls Chocolate Pumpkin Porter
description: All treat, no trick: this rich, robust Chocolate Pumpkin Porter is so good, even the living dead will indulge.

name: N2 Craft Stout
description: A dry Caribbean style stout with rich coffee and chocolate notes. Beautiful cascade and smooth velvety mouthfeel from the nitro.

name: Old Boy Classic Ale
description: Rich malt flavours of caramel, toffee and light chocolate. This ale is an ode to the pub beers of England. Well balanced flavours of malts and hops make this beer a classic.

name: Penny Farthing - English Mild
description: This English dark mild ale was brewed in collaboration with Country Malt Group to celebrate the World Cup. It features notes of hazelnuts and dark toast with a hint of brown sugar and raisin. Light and dry with a moderate bitterness, it is a highly crushable yet malty and flavorful ale long celebrated in British pub culture.

name: Pink Power Sour
description: Vibrant and empowering Tropical Hibiscus POG(passionfruit, orange, guava).

name: Rad-Berry Turbo Raspberry Lemonade Radler
description: This extra-strong raspberry lemon radler opens with an aromatic burst of sun-ripened berries and sharp, zesty citrus. Built on a crisp, clean lager base, it delivers a wave of juicy raspberry sweetness that is balanced by the refreshing, tart tang of lemonade.

name: Reckless Enthusiasm
description: We collaborated with Blind Enthusiasm Brewery in Edmonton to merge our award winning Brett Saison recipe and Blind Enthusiasm's house microbe culture sourced directly from their barrels. Dryhopped with Amarillo and Saphir after 4 months of fermentaion, then keg conditioned for natural carbonation. Passionfruit, lime, pineapple and apricot flavor with a hint of funk. Failry dry finish with gentle tannin and salinity in the aftertaste.

name: Red Sled Citra Amber Lager
description: This clean, easy-drinking amber lager has a light yet rich grainy malt with a hint of biscuit and nuttiness. A moderately low bitterness provides balance, with a citrus and herbal aroma from the restrained use of Citra hop. Its light amber color makes it an ideal companion for the colder season.

name: Schadenfreude Pumpkin Oktoberfest
description: This hearty, malty lager is warmed by the mighty pumpkin and lifted with notes of cinnamon, nutmeg, all-spice and ginger

name: Space Kitty
description: Hoppy, sessionable juicy IPA. Hop aroma of pineappple, mango, peach, pear, and lime from Mosaic, Amarillo and Citra Cryo dryhop. Light crisp grainy malt flavour. Light ceamy mouthfeel from oats and wheat. Great combination of juicy, hoppy, and sessionable.

name: Trash Panda Northeast Hazy IPA
description: Trash Panda uses huge amounts of dry hopping, giving this beer complex notes of melon, tropical fruit and pear. Its hop and malt varieties leave a visible haziness and smooth, juicy mouth feel.

name: Tricycle Grapefruit Radler
description: A classic German summer thirst-quenching mix of Bavarian lager and fresh grapefruit juice.

name: Ultraviolet Underground - Blueberry Lavender Sour
description: A unique sour brewed with lavender flowers and blueberries, this beer presents a fragrant and perfectly balanced fresh lavender aroma. The palate reveals a light blueberry flavor, finishing with a hint of blueberry skin polyphenol, all within a striking deep purple colour.

name: What's in Shed? - Tool Shed collab
description: This unique Session IPA, brewed in collaboration with Tool Shed Brewing in Calgary features the innovative Cryo Fresh Krush hops from Yakima Chief Hops. By using this concentrated, unkilned pellet hops made from harvest-fresh whole-cone hops, we've captured an incredibly vivid and intense aroma, bursting with notes ofred grapefruit, yuzu, guava, passionfruit, and a hint of gooseberry. Delivering assertive bitterness that yields to a refreshingly dry finish.

name: Player 1
description: This New England style hazy IPA is defined by bright notes of citurs, peach and tangerine.

name: House Hazy IPA
description: St Augustines Hazy IPA

name: House Lager
description: Bavarian-style craft lager by Parallel 49.

name: House Pale Ale
description: A true balance of malt and hops that showcase the bready,caramel flavours of malted barley and the citrus, stone-fruit aromas of hops grown in the Pacific Northwest. Refreshingly drinkable and full of flavour.

name: Salted Chocolate Porter
description: This porter offers a full body and rich chocolate flavours from a well-balanced combination of toasted and chocolate malts, while hand-harvested Pacific Ocean Fleur de Sel from Vancouver Island Salt Co. gives it an intriging floursh on the finish

name: Colour & Shape
description: This is the kind of IPA we dream about. Unfiltered so nothing of the greatness gets lost. It is soft, with lots of tropical fruit notes and a touch of herbal quality. Incredibly drinkable and super delicious.

name: Happyness IPA
description: A crisp malt body, green tropical fruit, lime, guava pepper notes and a soft bitterness. Hopped with Mosaic and Citra.

name: Premium Rice Lager
description: Extra light, dry, and refreshing, this lager has little floral and lemon notes from the hops combined with smoothness from the rice.

name: Golden Hour
description: A refreshing dry cider with a luminous straw-gold hue. Its aroma evokes fresh apple skins, with notes of cinnamon and vanilla, though no spices were added during its creation. Clean bright taste with refreshing tartness perfectly balanced by a touch of sweetness. Perfect for any occasion.

name: Lionheart London Porter
description: This London Porter is brewed with roasty, rich and velvety malts that honour the 18th-century British classic.

name: Salted Lime Lager
description: A light, latin american cerveza type beer with a modern twist. This is a crisp, clean lager made with Mexican limes and world-renowned salt sourced from El Valle Salado.

name: Merri Berri
description: A refreshing blend of local apples fermented slowly, then blended with black currant, cherry and raspberry juices. Sweet, but balanced with acidity and mild tannins from the berries.

name: Agave Maria - Tequila Shandy Sour
description: Crafted with real tequila, zesty lime, and a touch of sea salt, our Tequila Shandy Sour Ale offers a unique experience. The fragrant tequila aroma and refreshing lime zest blend seamlessly with a moderate, balanced sourness and a subtle salinity, creating the perfect summery, cocktail-inspired sour ale.

description: Brewed in collaboration with Country Malt Group to celebrate the World Cup, this hoppy session ale features the unique addition of fonio, an ancient African grain that lends tropical fruit notes. Idaho 7, Mosaic and Sabro hops contribute aromas of white wine, lychee, gooseberry and cataloupe, balanced by a subtle creamy character. It offers a soft, pillowy mouthfeel and a clean, refreshing bitterness.

name: Bierfest Hefeweizen
description: Unfiltered hazy German wheat ale. Light banana ester and clove phenol from a German wheat ale yeast. Bready, doughy wheat malt flavour with chewy, creamy mouthfeel.

name: Bierfest Schwarzbier
description: A dry, dark German lager with restraint roastiness. Moderate date chocolate notes on the crisp bready malt backbone. Light floral hop notes. Medium-high bitterness. Dry, very clean finish.

name: Cloud Breaker
description: This refreshing sour ale was brewed with real pineapple and coconut to capture the essence of a classic piña colada. The beer opens with a tropical aroma that leads into a light, clean sourness, making it incredibly quaffable. Perfectly balanced and very easy drinking.

name: Cobra Clutch DOUBLE IPA

Generously hopped with Ahtanum, Cascade, and Mosaic hops, it delivers juicy citrus, mango, and floral notes that perfectly complement its hazy and refreshing body. Despite its bold hop character and higher ABV, this DIPA remains smooth and easy-drinking, offering a fragrant and well-balanced experience. Ideal for hop enthusiasts, Cobra Clutch combines intensity with approachability in every sip.
